column2: (2) The Minister may direct the Council to furnish to him

column1: in such form as he may require, returns, accounts and any
other information relating to the work of the Council, and it
shall  be  the  duty  of  the  Council  to  give  effect  to  such
directions.

column2: The  Chief  Executive  Officer  and  the  officers  and

column1: employees  of  the  Council  shall  be  deemed  to  be  public
officers within the meaning of and for the purposes of the
Penal Code.

column2: The  Council  shall  be  deemed  to  be  a  Scheduled

column1: Institution within the meaning and for the purposes of the
Bribery Act and the provisions of that Act shall be construed
accordingly.

column2: (1)  Any  expense  incurred  by  the  Council  in  any

column1: suit or prosecution brought by or against it before any court,
shall be paid out of the Fund of the  Council and any costs
paid  to  or  recovered  by  the    Council    in  any  such  suit  or
prosecution shall be credited to the Fund of the  Council.

column2: (2)  Expenses  incurred  by  any  member,  the  Chief

column1: Executive Officer or any officer or employee of the  Council
in any suit or prosecution brought against such person before
any court or tribunal in respect of any act which is done or
purported to be done by  such person  under the provisions
of this Act or any other written law or on the direction of the
Council shall, if the court holds that such act was done in
good faith, be paid out  of the Fund of the  Council, unless
such expenses are recoverable by  such person in such suit
or prosecution.

column2: (1) The Minister may make regulations in respect of

column1: all matters required by this Act to be prescribed or in respect
of which regulations are authorized by this Act to be made.

column2: (2)  Every  regulation  made  by  the  Minister  shall  be

column1: published in the Gazette and shall come into operation on
the date of such publication, or on such later date as may be
specified in the regulations.
